dataset.name: CHA high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma cohort (GSE165808)
dataset.description: Independent Korean high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA-seq and individual progression-free-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Fresh-frozen primary tumors from 51 patients treated with surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy at CHA Bundang Medical Center from 2005 to 2014. TRACE Explorer retains the 47 patients with positive study-defined PFS time and explicit recurrence status.

metadata.source_program: CHA Bundang Medical Center HGSC cohort
metadata.redistribution_note: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution of GEO data but notes that submitters may retain intellectual-property rights. TRACE Explorer therefore enables analysis while disabling direct matrix redistribution.
metadata.curation_note: GEO supplies one primary-tumor RNA profile per patient. Four records lack a usable PFS time/status pair and are excluded, leaving 47 endpoint-complete patients with 37 recurrences and 10 censored observations. The supplied TPM matrix contains 20,416 unique rows encoded as HUGO|Entrez; the source symbols are retained without online remapping, and log2(TPM + 1) is applied once.

samples.sample_role: Fresh-frozen primary high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 20,416 supplied HUGO symbols are unique, including after case normalization; no source rows are merged.
expression.scale_note: GEO supplies non-negative RSEM TPM values for all 51 tumors. TRACE Explorer selects endpoint-complete columns and applies log2(TPM + 1) once; values remain cohort-specific.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source study baseline; the exact day-zero definition is not further specified by GEO
